escalation_runbook.content: Facilities Escalation Runbook v4.2. P1: any incident affecting data center cooling, power, life-safety, or business-critical infrastructure. Must be escalated within 30 minutes via a Jira incident in 'Operations Support', ops on-call paged, and a Confluence incident record created. P2: property/safety impact without critical-infra risk; escalate within 4 hours. P3: routine maintenance; handle in weekly queue. Escalation owner must confirm severity classification and on-call assignment before any incident record is filed.

INC-3318.content: Incident INC-3318. Location: Bldg C Data Center, Row 4. Description: CRAC-2 cooling unit tripped offline at 08:40; redundant CRAC-1 carrying full load; cold-aisle inlet temperature 31C and climbing ~1.5C per 15 min. Affected: 3 production racks (DB cluster, payment gateway, auth services). Severity assessed P1. Reported by L. Okafor (Facilities). Photos and sensor log attached. No ticket filed yet.

tools.name: query_facilities_incidents

tools.description: Read the Facilities Escalation Runbook to determine severity-based escalation requirements and ownership/confirmation rules.

tools.name: retrieve_incident_detail

tools.name: lookup_oncall_roster

tools.name: rank_incident_severity

tools.name: draft_incident_escalation_package
